outcome: delivery mode choices (vaginal delivery rate, cesarean section rate)
postpartum adaptation (Maternal Postnatal Attachment Scale, MPAS)
postpartum depression (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale, EPDS)
cohort: A total of 104 advanced maternal age primiparas who registered at the Tianshui Wulin Subdistrict Community Health Service Center's obstetrics clinic and delivered between January 2023 and December 2023 were enrolled.
finding: An individualized childbirth education program for advanced maternal age primiparas can effectively reduce childbirth anxiety, improve self-efficacy, increase vaginal delivery rates, and enhance postpartum psychological adaptation and breastfeeding outcomes.
mod_finding: The individualized childbirth education program significantly increased the rate of vaginal delivery (72.73% vs. 44.90%) and significantly lowered the cesarean section rate (21.82% vs. 46.94%) in the intervention group compared to the control group.
